plainTranslation: Steadying and heavy. The Saturn person grounds the Sun person, or controls them. Built to last; can feel restrictive. Watch criticism and the parent-child slide. Honesty about the weight keeps it commitment, not a cage.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
